0022600199.text: The Dallas Mavericks, now 5-4 with a 3-2 home record and a W1 streak, host the 2-6 Brooklyn Nets, who are on a W1 streak of their own, with Dallas sitting 10th in the West and Brooklyn 13th in the East. Dallas will be without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Brooklyn will be without Egor Demin (leg bruise). The Mavericks won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 123-114 win in Brooklyn on February 24, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season.
